question: Which accounting components explain the saved volatility-trail versus fixed-trail account differences, and does the shared-entry closed subset support investigating retention of long-trend winners?
population: All8155 original reclaim formations from six frozen2022-2023/2024-2025 main/chinext/star sources, paired across12 already-completed accounts. No new signal, account, selection, source fetch or2026 data.

rules.identity: Pair by period,board,original formationId/signalId, retaining every opportunity. Link filled buys by signalId, and closed/open episodes by symbol+entryDate plus exitDate for closed. bothSameEntry requires identical actual entryDate AND buy fill price; different quantity or investedAmount remains a capital-size difference. Never join sells by signalId or signalDate.
rules.investment: I is the original episode investedAmount, reconciled to actual buy amount+fee. Filled amount already includes slippage; do not subtract it twice. No use of riskEntryPrice, planned budget or remaining cost basis as I. Reject unexpected top-ups or rights cashflow rather than silently reinterpreting this denominator.
rules.pnl: Closed P is complete net episode PnL. Open P is realizedPnLWhileOpen+unrealizedPnL at the original cutoff, explicitly retained as marked-to-market and not treated as a closed trade. Unentered P=0 is an accounting contribution, not hypothetical trade return.
rules.decomposition: For both-entered pairs r=P/I in fractions: Pv-Pc=mean(I)*(rv-rc)+mean(r)*(Iv-Ic). Name these returnProfileComponent and committedCapitalComponent; they are symmetric algebraic components, not causal treatment effects. Single-sided contributions are +Pv for candidateOnly and -Pc for controlOnly; neither contributes zero.
rules.bridge: Sum all pair components then add candidate-minus-control original unallocated account residual. Reconcile to the original complete-account net-PnL difference. Retain every12 account bridge separately; do not add independent accounts into a portfolio return.
rules.maturity: Retain all9 cross-policy closed/openAtCutoff/notEntered states. Only bothSameEntry with both episodes closed enters exit-timing and baseline-outcome descriptive comparisons. Longer/same/shorter means the actual candidate exit date relative to control; it is not a future executable selector.
rules.time: Full episodes belong to their original formation year and formation epoch. 2024-09-24 is descriptive only; episode PnL can be earned later. Inherit continuous original9.24 curve intervals without recomputing or resetting accounts.
rules.scope: No profit, win-rate, payoff or holding-period acceptance hurdle. All periods and boards remain. Repeated stocks, overlapping opportunities and path-dependent admission are not independent randomized observations. No holdout or stable-profit claim.
